run_model_evaluation: run the scoring script to evaluate a ResNet model on ImageNet validation data
run_parse_args: run parse_args to parse CLI arguments for model type, batch size, and GPU count
run_test_function: run the test function to compute top1 and top5 accuracy on validation batches
run_get_data_loader: run get_data_loader to create a DataLoader from raw ImageNet image directories
run_get_data_rec: run get_data_rec to create an ImageRecordIter from MXNet record files
